spans.s:
Kekaya is the name of a tribe which in later days, and probably also in Vedic times, was settled in the north-west, oetween the sindhu (Indus) and vitastā. In the Vedic texts the Kekayas are mentioned indirectly only in the name of their prince aśvapati kaikeya.
Foot notes Pargiter, Journal of the Royal Asiatic Society, 1908, 317, 332.
Śatapatha brāhmaṇa, x. 6, 1, 2. et seq.; Chāndogya upaniṣad, v. 11, 4.
Cf. Weber, Indian Litenature, 120; Indische Studien, 1, 126.
